rules: Do not use Lanchester factors in adjudication.
Do not replace table lookup with continuous damage formulas.
Do not interpolate, smooth, fit, or silently fill table cells.
Unknown source numeric codes remain UNKNOWN until mapped.
Every roll and lookup must be recorded in replay evidence.
